title.en: The Paper River: How Will You Cross?
title.zh: 纸上河流：你会怎么过河？

description.en: Six choices on a tabletop river map about testing a route, coordinating a crossing and choosing a workable pace. A fictional puzzle, not outdoor safety advice.
description.zh: 在桌面河流地图上做六次选择，试路线、协作过河、安排节奏。这是虚构小游戏，不提供真实户外安全建议。

introduction.en: The river is drawn on paper and the travelers are tokens. You can erase a bridge and try again, so no real crossing or risk is involved. Follow how you would solve this small map problem with a companion.
introduction.zh: 河流画在纸上，旅客只是棋子。桥可以擦掉重画，不涉及真实涉水风险。按你愿意的方式，与同伴一起解这张小地图的问题。

focus.en: Trying a reversible route, agreeing on assistance and keeping a tabletop challenge within a chosen pace.
focus.zh: 尝试可撤回路线、约定协助，并让桌面挑战保持合适节奏。

prompt.en: Three paper bridges connect the banks. Your first move is…
prompt.zh: 三座纸桥连接两岸，你的第一步是……

label.en: Move one token along a short route to see how it works.
label.zh: 先用一枚棋子走短路，看看规则怎么运行。

label.en: Ask the other player which token they want to move together.
label.zh: 问同伴想一起移动哪枚棋子。

label.en: Choose an easy route that leaves time to pause.
label.zh: 选一条容易的路，留时间停一停。

prompt.en: The first drawn bridge ends one square short. You…
prompt.zh: 第一座画出的桥差一格，你会……

label.en: Extend it with one erasable line and test again.
label.zh: 添一条可擦线，再试一次。

label.en: Set the tokens aside while you rethink the next move.
label.zh: 先放下棋子，重新想下一步。

label.en: Ask your companion to draw while you move a token.
label.zh: 请同伴画线，自己移动棋子。

prompt.en: One player likes quick moves and one likes long pauses. You…
prompt.zh: 一个玩家喜欢快走，一个喜欢长停顿，你会……

label.en: Agree on turns with room for both rhythms.
label.zh: 约好轮次，给两种节奏留空间。

label.en: Pair up for a single move before separating again.
label.zh: 先共同完成一步，再各自走。

label.en: Try a brief timed round and then discuss it.
label.zh: 试一段短计时回合，再讨论感受。

prompt.en: A route needs two tokens at once. You prefer…
prompt.zh: 一条路需要同时移动两枚棋子，你更愿意……

label.en: A clear count-in so each player knows the shared step.
label.zh: 清楚倒数，让双方知道共同一步。

label.en: A practice move with spare tokens first.
A slower crossing with an agreed stopping square.
label.zh: 慢一点走，并约定停在哪一格。

prompt.en: You could add a harder bridge to the map. You…
prompt.zh: 可以在地图上添一座难桥，你会……

label.en: Keep the current challenge if it already feels satisfying.
label.zh: 若当前挑战已满足，就先保留它。

label.en: Add one trial bridge that can be erased easily.
label.zh: 添一座容易擦掉的试验桥。

label.en: Ask whether the other player wants to build it with you.
label.zh: 问同伴是否想一起建这座桥。

prompt.en: Which last image would you put on the game box?
prompt.zh: 给游戏盒选最后一幅图，你选……

label.en: Two tokens crossing on a clearly shared cue.
label.zh: 两枚棋子按共同信号过河。

label.en: An erased route beside the small bridge that finally worked.
label.zh: 擦掉的旧路线旁，一座终于可行的小桥。

label.en: A crossing with a pleasant stopping place halfway.
label.zh: 一条中途有舒服歇脚处的路线。

summary.en: Your paper crossing develops through small reversible trials. A short move reveals more than a perfectly imagined route, and an erased line can be part of the solution. The portrait applies to this tabletop story rather than real-world risk taking.
summary.zh: 你的纸上过河靠一次次可撤回小尝试推进。走一小步，比只想象完美路线更有信息；擦掉的线也是解法的一部分。画像只对应桌面故事，不评价现实冒险。

example.en: When learning a new board-game move, you might use a spare piece to demonstrate one turn before committing the actual game pieces to it.
example.zh: 学习一种新桌游走法时，你可能用备用棋子演示一回合，再让正式棋子走。

strength.en: A bounded trial makes uncertainty visible and can reveal a mistaken assumption before it becomes part of a larger arrangement.
strength.zh: 有边界的尝试让不确定可见，也能在错误假设进入更大安排前发现它。

tradeoff.en: Trying repeatedly can become aimless if you never name what each attempt is meant to show; a small question helps the next move matter.
tradeoff.zh: 若不说明每次要看什么，反复试也可能失去方向；一个小问题让下一步有意义。

experiment.en: For a harmless hobby puzzle, define one tiny question and make one reversible trial. Keep the useful observation even if you erase the first route.
experiment.zh: 面对一个无害爱好小难题，定一个小问题，做一次可撤回尝试。即便擦掉路线，也保留有用观察。

summary.en: Your route becomes clearer when the crossing is shared explicitly. You choose signals, roles and moments of coordination rather than assuming another token will follow. This ending values a negotiated joint move, not compulsory togetherness in every situation.
summary.zh: 你的路线在明确协作时变清楚。你选择信号、分工与配合时刻，不假定另一枚棋子自然跟随。结局珍惜商量后的共同行动，不要求任何情境都结伴。

example.en: During a two-person model build, you might ask one person to hold a piece while the other connects it, then swap roles when that helps.
example.zh: 双人拼模型时，你可能约一人扶住、一人连接，有用时再交换角色。

strength.en: An agreed shared step can reduce guessing and make help specific enough that both people can decide whether they want it.
strength.zh: 约定的共同一步减少猜测，也让帮助具体到双方都能决定是否愿意。

tradeoff.en: Coordination costs attention too. A task that either player can comfortably do alone may not need a meeting before every move.
tradeoff.zh: 配合也消耗注意。一人即可自在完成的事，不必每移动一步都开会。

experiment.en: In one small shared activity, ask what help would actually be useful. Agree on a single joint step and leave the rest flexible.
experiment.zh: 在一项小共同活动中，问清什么帮助确实有用。只约定一个协作步骤，其余保持灵活。

summary.en: Your map gives the crossing a pace people can choose. An easy bridge and a halfway stop are part of the game rather than signs that it is being played badly. The ending prefers a satisfying challenge over an automatically harder one.
summary.zh: 你的地图给过河留了可选择的节奏。容易的桥与半途歇脚，都是游戏一部分，不说明玩得差。结局偏向让人满足的挑战，而非自动选择更难。

example.en: At a casual puzzle afternoon, you might finish a comfortable round and pause for conversation instead of raising the difficulty as soon as someone succeeds.
example.zh: 休闲解谜下午，你可能完成一轮合适难度后聊一会儿，不因有人成功就立刻加难。

strength.en: A chosen pace can make a shared activity easier to enjoy across different energy levels, without turning every pause into a problem to solve.
strength.zh: 可选择的节奏让精力不同的人更容易享受活动，不必把每次停顿都当问题处理。

tradeoff.en: The easiest route may eventually stop being interesting; pacing includes noticing when you actually want a new challenge rather than avoiding every change.
tradeoff.zh: 最容易的路也可能渐渐无趣；安排节奏也包括发现何时真想挑战，不是回避所有变化。

experiment.en: Before adding difficulty to a recreational activity, ask whether you want more challenge or more enjoyment of the current round. Choose either deliberately.
experiment.zh: 给休闲活动加难前，问自己想要更多挑战，还是继续享受当前一轮。两者都可主动选择。
